ledger.note: 1682 (May): the Brandenburg African Company is founded and the Gold Coast colony begins at Cape Three Points. 'In May 1682, the German colonization of Africa began when the newly founded Brandenburg African Company'; the colony 'existed from 1682 to 1701, after which it became a Prussian colony from 1701 to 1721'. The page gives no year or treaty for the land.
1684 (April): Fort Dorothea is added. 'Fort Dorothea: (April 1684 - 1687, 1698-1711, April 1712 - 1717)'.
1687: the Dutch occupy Fort Dorothea. 'from 1687 to 1698 ... the Dutch occupied' Fort Dorothea.
1698: Fort Dorothea is Brandenburger again. 'Fort Dorothea: ... 1698-1711'.

1701 (15 January): the colony becomes the Prussian Gold Coast Settlements. Infobox 'Renamed Prussian Gold Coast Settlements: 15 January 1701'; 'Brandenburger colony (1682-1701), Prussian colony (1701-1721)'.
1711: the Dutch occupy Fort Dorothea again. 'From 1711 to April 1712, the Dutch occupied Fort Dorothea.'
1712 (April): Fort Dorothea returns to Prussia. 'Fort Dorothea: ... April 1712 - 1717'.

1717: Prussia abandons Groß Friedrichsburg. 'In 1717, the Prussian Gold Coast colony was physically abandoned by Prussia'; John Konny 'occupied Groß Friedrichsburg' from then until 1724, 'despite the sale of the colony to the Dutch in 1721'.
1717: Fort Dorothea passes out of Prussian hands. The page lists Fort Dorothea as Prussian until 1717 and names no later holder.

1721: Prussia sells the colony to the Dutch. 'In 1721, King Frederick William I of Prussia sold it for 7,200 ducats and 12 slaves to the Dutch West India Company' after 39 years of rule; infobox 'Sold to Netherlands: 1721'.

wars.name: Dutch occupation of Fort Dorothea
wars.outcome: The Dutch occupied Fort Dorothea from 1687 to 1698 and from 1711 to April 1712; Prussia held it again after each.
wars.note: The page gives no battles; the Dutch dossier carries the same dates (gains 1687 and 1711, losses 1698 and 1712).

certainty.note: Two coastal forts with land around them; the page gives no boundary for either, so the circles are soft.

sources.title: Brandenburger Gold Coast
sources.note: Infobox (colony 1682-1701, Prussian 1701-1721, capital Groß Friedrichsburg, May 1682, 15 January 1701, 1721), the fort dates, Dutch occupations, abandonment 1717, Konny to 1724, sale 1721; no area, no 1682-83 treaty.

notes: Brandenburger Gold Coast has no Cliopatria row. One page opened (budget 1-2). It gives no area and no acquisition treaty or year for the land; the circles are small stand-ins centred on the two forts (Princess Town and Akwidaa) whose names the gazetteer lacks (af-04-a already lists them). The Dutch Gold Coast dossier (af-04-a) uses brandenburg-prussia as its counterpart for the 1687, 1698, 1711, 1712 and 1721 events; the matching counterpart here is dutch-gold-coast and the metropole is brandenburg-prussia (Cliopatria 1619-1720) and, after 1701, the Kingdom of Prussia. 1717-1721: no land drawn, because the page has the colony 'physically abandoned' and Groß Friedrichsburg held by John Konny to 1724; Fort Dorothea's holder after 1717 is not on the page (confidence-1 loss to nobody). Gazetteer names needed: Princess Town and Akwidaa (Ghana).
